# Who's using GGUF Parser

GGUF Parser is used by a growing range of companies and projects to parse GGUF model files and estimate their memory usage and maximum tokens per second without downloading entire files.

If you are using GGUF Parser and your name is not on this list, please send us a PR!

## Companies/Projects using GGUF Parser in production

These companies and projects are using GGUF Parser in production. If your company is using GGUF Parser, open a PR to add your company or project name and a description of how you are using GGUF Parser.
